label: PF Backlog 425
title: B1: PF Go core (Go<->Python seam)
body: [B1] Minimal native Go host; new shipped/sensitive features land here. Build COMPILES (go build), never translates.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/build_manager.py, core/build_utility.py, core/tier_builder.py, /api/v1/packaging/build

missing: Seam transport decision (subprocess vs gRPC vs FFI)
context_review.reason: The architecture policy and ADR are settled; the candidate components and packaging API give a clear integration point. What remains are design decisions the implementing engineer can make or escalate, not blockers to starting.

brief.problem: New shipped/sensitive features must not be added to Python (IP-protection + packaging). A compiled Go host is needed from day one.
brief.what_adds: B1 — a minimal native Go host: new shipped/sensitive logic lands here. The host COMPILES (go build); it never 'translates' existing code.
brief.why: Avoid deferred rework: new shipped/sensitive logic is Go from day one behind the A1 seam.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: B1 — a minimal native Go host: new shipped/sensitive logic lands here. The host COMPILES (go build); it never 'translates' existing code.
acceptance_criteria: a new feature implemented in Go is invoked from the PF runtime
approach: Create a tiny Go host; wire the A1 Go<->Python contract; route new shipped/sensitive features to Go.
verification: a new feature implemented in Go is invoked from the PF runtime
out_of_scope: existing Python features (stay compiled, not rewritten here)

api_impact.reason: no API surface declared in backend_capability
